key_insight: Process-zone condensation exactly reproduces the full discretized composite cell while plasticity stays inside the retained zone, without training.
engineering_relevance: The method can accelerate FE² simulations of composites with fibre–matrix debonding and matrix plasticity while preserving macroscopic stress and consistent tangent.
method: Eliminate the linear elastic cell remainder using a Schur complement.
Retain interface and process-zone variables; recover stress and tangent through influence matrices.
Back-substitute once per increment to check that the eliminated matrix remains elastic.
evidence_signal: Eight of nine 2D paths matched full-cell stress and tangent to 1e-11; aggregate 2D speed-up was 3.3× excluding setup and checks, while plate simulations were 1.51× faster for glass/polypropylene but slower for glass/epoxy.
watch_item: Exactness requires the eliminated region to remain elastic; zone expansion and adaptation costs can erase speed gains, as seen in the certified 3D cases.
paper_title: Process-zone condensation: a discretization-exact reduced cell model for FE$^2$ analysis of composites with fibre-matrix debonding and matrix plasticity
